verdict.rationale: GrowthBook can be fully self-hosted via Docker Compose on your own infrastructure (including data store, API, and front-end), which lets a customer choose exactly where their data lives — a strong route to data residency/region control. However, there's no evidence of an explicit region-selection feature for GrowthBook Cloud (e.g., EU vs US hosting options within the managed SaaS), so residency choice is only available to self-hosters, not cloud users. Missing for 10: documented cloud multi-region hosting options, explicit data-residency/compliance certifications (e.g., GDPR data location guarantees) for the managed offering.
